branchless.restack.warnAbandoned.reason: Upstream declares RESTACK_WARN_ABANDONED_CONFIG_KEY and never reads it. The live key is branchless.hint.restackWarnAbandoned.

branchless.core.mainBranch.defaultDescription: computed: `branchless.mainBranch`, then `init.defaultBranch`, then `master`. `git branchless init` writes a value into every repository it initializes.

branchless.core.protectCheckedOutBranche.note: Only this repository's build reads this key: its protect-checked-out-branches patch adds it. Upstream git-branchless ignores it.

branchless.revsets.alias.<name>.description: Revset aliases: `<name>` becomes callable as `<name>()` in any revset. `$1` is replaced with the first argument, `$2` with the second, and so on. A name that matches a builtin revset function is never used, because builtins are looked up first.

branchless.test.alias.<name>.description: Named test commands for `git test run -c <name>`. The alias named `default` runs when neither `--command` nor `--exec` is given.

branchless.test.jobs.defaultDescription: unset, which runs 1 job. A configured value never changes the execution strategy: only the command-line `--jobs` above 1 switches to the `worktree` strategy, so a value above 1 with `branchless.test.strategy` left at `working-copy` makes every `git test run` fail. The value is read and validated even when `--jobs` is given, and a negative value is an error.
branchless.test.jobs.description: Default number of parallel jobs for `git test run`. `0` runs one job per physical CPU.
